model.name: eb-insights
model.description: Feature-based Poisson GLMs (EWMA attack/defence of goals, shots on target, corners, cards, fouls; own Elo; rest days; league means) per count market, Dixon-Coles low-score correction for goals, negative-binomial totals for corners/cards. Independent of Engine A.

FIRST_TO_SCORE.note: assumes goals follow independent Poisson processes (no in-match dynamics)

RED.note: league base rate (team-level red-card modelling is not statistically defensible)
